arguments.text: Settle now. Long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Start was hot (pod reserve 58 pct at 1 min). Plan: settle to just above critical power (pod about 205-215 W, pace about 148-152 over ground, adjust for current per leg) through 4800 m, keep pod reserve above about 25 pct until 1000 m to go, then build; finish sprint from about 400 m. Watch for drag incidents (push_local drop at steady pod power = weed on rudder or similar), instrument drift (pod vs boat power disagree), radio course changes.
